blockers.description: Worktree editable-install pollution: after a worktree executor is removed, `from maccat ...` raises ModuleNotFoundError on main because pip's editable install repointed to the (now deleted) worktree path. The post-merge test suite collection-errors on EVERY test until fixed.
blockers.workaround: Run `./venv/bin/pip install -e .` on main BEFORE running `./venv/bin/pytest tests/` after any worktree merge.

decisions.decision: Markdown format: ---fenced YAML frontmatter (snake_case keys computer/hostname/generated/maccat_version, generated double-quoted ISO-8601), title stays '# Installed Mac Software List', 3-col Name|Version|ID tables with empty cells + \| escaping, raw Homebrew/mas sections rendered in the SAME table via a duplicated ITEM_RE, (none found) line for empty sources, LC_ALL=C sort -f -u preserved.
decisions.rationale: Locked in 30-CONTEXT.md smart-discuss; byte-deterministic + round-trippable for Phase 31 parser.
